label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: La fiesta de los panes ázimos guardarás; siete días comerás panes ázimos, conforme a lo que te mandé, al tiempo de mes del Aviv, porque en él saliste desde Egipto; y no se verán mis faces vacíos.
spanish: La fiesta de los panes ázimos guardarás; siete días comerás panes ázimos, conforme a lo que te mandé, al tiempo señalado del mes de las espigas, porque en él saliste desde Egipto; y no se verán mis faces vacío.
grammarChanges: Translated h02023015013 (הָאָבִיב, article + common noun 'green/young ears of grain') as 'las espigas' instead of leaving it as the untranslated proper name 'Aviv', per the auditor fail; matches the fix already applied at Éxodo 13:4.

Added the article in 'del mes' (de + el) since the construct phrase becomes fully definite once the nomen rectum is the common noun 'las espigas' rather than a bare proper name, matching the Éxodo 13:4 precedent.
Rendered h02023015011 (לְמוֹעֵד) as 'tiempo señalado' instead of generic 'tiempo', per the auditor warn; matches the project's standing rendering of מוֹעֵד (H4150) elsewhere.

Changed 'vacíos' to the invariant singular 'vacío' (h02023015020/h02023015021) so the adverb רֵיקָם no longer reads as an adjective attaching emptiness to the grammatically plural 'mis faces'; it instead agrees with the implied visitor, matching the parallel refrain at Deuteronomio 16:16 ('no será visto faces de Jehová vacío').
readerNote: Chose the invariant singular 'vacío' over plural 'vacíos' because רֵיקָם is adverbial and belongs with the implied visitor, not with the grammatically plural 'mis faces'; the parallel refrain in Deuteronomio 16:16 makes the same choice.
